messages:
Ben (Product): Hey team — flew in yesterday and my checked bag didn’t arrive (BA delay ref BAG-9987). Had to buy emergency clothes + toiletries at the airport because I had a customer lunch the next day. Paid on personal card: clothing £120, toiletries £18, plus a £25 surge taxi when the shuttle was cancelled. Corporate card also failed at check-in. Two questions: 1) can we reimburse emergency essentials and the taxi surge? 2) can I also claim per-diem for that partial day instead of receipts? Laura is on a customer site today and might be slow to sign.

Iris (People Ops): Short: we cover reasonable emergency essentials (clothes, basic toiletries) up to £200 with receipts when baggage is delayed; taxis due to lack of alternatives can be considered but surge premiums are reviewed case-by-case. Per-diem cannot be claimed if you submit receipts for the same day (no double-dipping). If Laura can’t approve quickly, escalate to finance-approvals@redwood.com and CC people-ops — they can triage urgent reimbursements up to £300.

Sam (Finance): Finance process: 1) upload your receipts and the carrier delay report (BAG-9987). Airlines usually provide a delay/irregularity form — we need that to code the expense as "baggage delay" for audit and VAT handling. 2) For the taxi surge: provide a short note explaining shuttle cancellation + receipt. If surge was unavoidable (no public transit/alternate), we may reimburse net of a reasonable cap; if it was elective (you chose private car), we may decline the surge portion. 3) If corporate card attempt failed, include a screenshot of the failed auth or bank decline.

Laura (Manager): I’m in the client meeting but saw this. Provisional approval for emergency clothes (£120) and toiletries (£18). I approve taxi reimbursement up to £15 (reasonable alternative); I don’t approve the extra surge premium beyond that unless Sam flags it necessary. Ben, tag me in the expense and I’ll formally approve when I return.

Travel Bot: Reminder — submit within 30 days. Required uploads: airline delay report or email, itemized receipts, screenshot of corporate card decline (if applicable). Use tag: "lost-luggage" and category: Travel > Incident. Help: https://redwood.example/docs/expenses#lost-baggage

Ben (Product): Uploaded airline delay PDF, receipts for clothes + toiletries, taxi receipt and screenshot of the card decline. Noted "taxi surge due to shuttle cancellation at 22:40" in the expense description and tagged Laura + finance-approvals. Thanks all.
